title: 8 Signs a Godly Man Handles Praise Better Than He Handles Criticism
caption:
The crucible is for silver, the furnace for gold, and a man is tested by the praise he receives (Proverbs 27:21).

Failure isn't usually what takes a man out. Praise is quieter and it's patient.

8 signs he's actually passing that test: redirecting the compliment, staying suspicious of a season with no correction in it, giving credit away faster than he takes it.

He'd rather be corrected by a brother than admired by a crowd. Only one of them actually loves him.
